notes: All visible detail comes from the untouched ImageGen originals; processing only registers, trims and encodes.
Alpha bounds are fitted to the common guide. Bounding-box fitting does not prove that internal painted curvature or endpoint details match mathematical geometry.
Use each unique orientation with rotation 0 and no flips. Scale the entire kit uniformly if changing its radius.
Ground anchors and collision polygons are deterministic; inspect real sprite joins and front-to-back ordering before game integration.
This is a complete closed-ring asset kit. Existing road openings require deliberately selected or shortened end pieces; no live layout is changed.
